subject: Discovery recap + next steps: buyer verification & procurement onramp
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearpath.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T15:12:00Z
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps: buyer verification & procurement onramp

Hi Samira — great conversation earlier, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard:
- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for R&D model serving (gen2 models) to speed internal retrieval and embed search. Primary success metric: 30% reduction in end-to-end latency for inference at 95th percentile.
- Initial scope: 2 production models, internal-only traffic, sensitive PHI-adjacent datasets (will need VPC + KMS).
- Timeline: pilot kick-off in September; procurement/PO by mid-October if pilot shows perf/cost wins.

Key asks from your side:
1) Confirm economic buyer / budget owner for this project (title/contact).
2) Provide procurement/security intake steps and expected timeline (SOC 2, SLAs, insurance certificates).

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
- Rishi: Intro outreach to economic buyer + attach high-level SOW and SLA summary (attached).
- Lauren & Dev: prepare a one-page security packet + sample MSA redline and mutual action plan (will share within 48h).
- Samira: confirm buyer contact and preferred procurement PO process.

Attachments: redwood-sla-summary.pdf (summary of SLAs + breach response), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (template).

If that matches your view, can you please confirm the econ buyer (name/email) and whether procurement prefers a GCP marketplace listing or direct PO? Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up with any stakeholders.

Best,

Lauren/Dev — forwarding the recap I just sent to Samira. Two quick asks so we can be ready once Samira confirms the econ buyer: 

Lauren: can you assemble a one-pager security packet (SOC 2 scope, data residency, KMS options, logs/audit retention) and a short list of common contract redlines we can accept vs. need legal? Aim for a 2-slide PDF.

Dev: can you pull a sample SOW template that calls out pilot scope (models, QPS, latency SLOs), estimated GPU capacity, and a conservative cost projection? Also include an abbreviated runbook for VPC setup (customer-managed subnets + peering notes).

Timeline: need drafts by EOD Friday (2027-08-06) so I can include them in the intro to the economic buyer and procurement. I'm happy to edit/shape the language for an exec audience.

Thanks — r

From: Samira Khan <samira@clearpath.io>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps: buyer verification & procurement onramp

Hi Rishi — thanks for the concise recap. That aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications: 

1) Economic buyer / budget owner: Priya Desai, VP Finance (priya@atlanticbio.com). She signs POs for pilot budgets up to $150k; anything above usually routes to CFO.

2) Procurement/security intake: 
- We run a short security questionnaire (we use a vendor intake form) — SOC 2 Type II report is required for pilots that touch PHI-adjacent data.
- Contracting: Procurement prefers a short SOW + PO to start; MSA negotiations happen in parallel. Standard insurance requirements attached to PO.
- Timeline: If we have SOW + security packet by 8/13, procurement can issue a PO by ~8/27.

3) Preferred procurement route: direct PO to Redwood, but they will accept marketplace billing if price parity is maintained.

I'll intro you to Priya here — she prefers brief emails with the pilot outcomes/metrics up front. cc'ing her.

Best,
Samira
Head of ML Ops, ClearPath (contracting via Atlantic Bio)
samira@clearpath.io

- We optimize GPU-backed inference and KV/prefix caching to reduce tail latency without heavy engineering lift from your team.
- Pilot deliverables: SOW + runbook, a security packet including SOC 2 summary and KMS options, and a short report on latency and cost savings.

Attached: redwood-sla-summary.pdf (SLA + security highlights) and mutual-action-plan.xlsx (example SOW + milestones).

Lauren & team are prepared to send the security one-pager and a cleaned SOW for your review by EOD 8/06.

Thanks for taking a look — happy to be flexible on timing/process to make procurement easy.
